description: First driver script (/tmp/dbi_bib_rerun_runner.sh) omitted A/T1 and A/T2 from the test loop. R2's reconstruction session captured only A/T3-A/T5 + B/T1-B/T5 = 8/10 valid outputs. remediation: R2 quarantined at runs/_quarantine_R2_partial/R2/ — preserved as audit evidence of the partial capture. R2 re-run from scratch with v2 driver.
